title: Finastra - Core banking and payments infrastructure software for financial institutions
clean_text: Finastra delivers core banking, lending, and payments infrastructure software to more than 7,000 financial institution customers worldwide, including 80% of the top 50 global banks. Formed in 2017 through a merger of two established fintech providers and majority-owned by Vista Equity Partners, Finastra serves both traditional institutions modernizing legacy core systems and digital-native banks needing enterprise-grade infrastructure, across retail, SME, commercial, and Islamic banking. Its Universal Banking platform and Essence next-generation core (built on microservices and open APIs) are offered in both on-premise and cloud-hosted deployments.
